funding_timing: 18:50 MSK before 2026-03-23; 23:50 MSK from 2026-03-23. Official history clearing dates only; native weekend observations are not independent funding days.
daily_semantics: D1 denotes calendar-date OHLC aggregated from native tradedate as in project D1 panel, available conservatively at following midnight. It is not official exchange trading-session OHLC, which differs historically. All H1 pivots use consecutive complete observed hours, which can be separated by incomplete hours/session breaks; two confirmation bars can take longer than two clock hours.
funding_stress: Alongside base timing, calculate +/- one official clearing-row shift of SWAPRATE and +10 minutes clearing time as mapping/timing sensitivity. Missing funding remains explicit adverse approximation, never zero.
timestamp_uncertainty: Intrabar executions use minute/bar end as timestamp upper bound; actual stop time is unknown within bar. This affects funding near clearing; sensitivity is mandatory.
